gen-gf-farsan-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded spreads its classic serif letters out wide, each one floating free with open counters, while Farsan above it keeps no hairlines at all. Farsan hits hard; Stint lets words breathe.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-cascadia-code: Faustina leads with a barely tilted nib, its strokes swelling and thinning like tapered glass rods, with a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals. Cascadia Code answers in wire-like monoline, with sans arches as thick as its stems and generous gaps between neighbors.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-cascadia-mono: Authoritative and classic, Faustina draws a subtle gradient of weight along every curve, and its c opens like a bent paperclip. And Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board, with curves as thick as its straight stems.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-julius-sans-one: Calligraphic meets stripped-back: Faustina carries moderate shading across round and straight strokes, with a nib-drawn, slightly tilted feel. Julius Sans One has no stroke contrast at all, and over a long stretch its wide gaps between letters keep the text light and open.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-lexend-exa: Sturdy hairlines and a calligraphy-nib slant give Faustina its authority up top. Lexend Exa traces every line with one marker tip, so a long passage feels steady, with a big x-height and stubby ascenders.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga reads flat and single-weight, like letters bent from one length of wire, with generous tracking that opens each word. Over a long passage it moves smoothly and without fuss, while Faustina above adds modest stress in its curves.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega reads as though drawn with one nib, its body height nearly matching the capitals and a visible gap between the ends of every c. Over a long passage it runs smoothly, with Faustina above adding gentle swelling on its curves.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads with curves that never thin out, and a big x-height with tight ascender room. Across a long passage it feels plain and steady, with Faustina above weighing thread against yarn in its strokes.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera reads like a plotter pen at work, with letters spaced like stepping stones. Over a long passage that single-weight line stays open and regular, while Faustina above keeps a restrained thick and thin in every glyph.
gen-gf-faustina-gf-lexend-zetta: Tall, ribbon-cut letters spread wide: Lexend Zetta runs a marker-nib line that ignores direction, while Faustina brings thin strokes only slightly lighter than its thick ones. Faustina has the nib-drawn authority; Lexend Zetta has the easy, open spacing.
